        "All owned hunks across 14 paths were read. Both comm SubDialogManager option lists add variables.css. Seven document paths remove a direct variables link; directory-edit and identity-edit also remove icons.css. News and IM main pages instead gain explicit colors.css and variables.css. These are distinct document/manager roles, not a general import-removal rule.",
        "The exact accepted Preferences SubDialogManager43–55 proof already exists publicly and is reused whole by ID/time, not recreated. The actual configureFonts caller opens fonts.xhtml through gSubDialog. The Account Manager options are separately inspected. Remaining address-book/identity opener routes and the upstream manager's injection timing are bounded; this does not prove variables are available in every possible standalone opener.",
        "The owned selector broadens #preferencesContainer richlistbox to richlistbox:not(#categories), absorbs formerly separated hover/focus rules and adds 12px inline-start row padding. The actual Preferences navigation list uses categories; directory selection uses directoriesList. The selectedLocales-specific 13px rule is removed in favor of the shared row rule. Matching/cascade in a live document was not rendered.",
        "Shared common.css adds a 9px panel radius and 4px 0 popup padding, and replaces variable block padding with explicit 3px 6px item padding while retaining 24px minimum block size. The changed button variable family aliases hover/active values to existing light-dark tokens; input text radius follows button radius and the toolkit primary-disabled background follows primary. Later additional tokens are not attributed to this landing.",
        "Manual style review checks logical padding, selector exclusion and CSS-variable receiver scope. The toolkit wrapper comment identifies an integration role. The review's button-unification suggestion is adopted in the actual aliases, but Done/acceptance does not establish color contrast, forced-colors, focus, platform geometry or runtime parity. No tests/assertions are changed.",
        "Full primary2043995 and D303745 are retained. The primary expects more Nova changes later; review author comments explain toolkit password dialogs and shared Account Manager/Settings dialogs. Its three actual bodies include one replacement table. Preference instructions were read, not executed. Existing CSS-import exception knowledge is reused narrowly; no deliberate instruction change.",
        "Primary Bug2043995 original A current0–3/activity/footer is complete. Its author anticipates more Nova changes later, and later status updates do not establish visual results.",
        "Own D303745 full timeline and three actual submitted outdated inline bodies, including one complete replacement table, were read. Author explains toolkit password/shared dialog variable needs; reviewer asks to unify active/hover tokens. Actual owned/accepted aliases adopt that request. Done and acceptance are not source or runtime proof.",
        "All14 owned paths were read. The two manager options, seven direct variables-link removals, two icon-link removals and explicit News/IM colors+variables links retain their exact distinct roles. The actual fonts opener and manager are checked; other opener/injection/cascade paths stay bounded.",
        "The existing published CSS-import exception lesson faa9ef03… and whole accepted Preferences manager source125b6511… are reused by exact identity/bytes/blob/original time. No duplicate manager source object or new general import rule. New lesson covers actual list exclusion, shared padding and button token families.",
